jobs.title: Application Support Engineer [L2]
jobs.description:
About Sedna

Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to mature and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

About the role

This is where you come in. As an Application Support Engineer (L2), you'll be part of a support team spanning Cape Town, Athens, and colleagues across Norway and South America, giving us close to round-the-clock coverage and a genuinely global view of our customers. You'll split your time between L1 and L2 work depending on what's coming through, which keeps things varied and means no two days look quite the same.

The problems that land with you won't always have an obvious answer. You'll get into API issues, integration quirks, and the finer detail of how the platform behaves under pressure, working closely with Engineering and Product to get to the bottom of things and feed what you learn back into a better product.

Every fix you land keeps a shipowner, operator, or broker moving, and every improvement you help drive makes things a little easier for the next customer who needs it. That's the kind of impact this role carries.

Your responsibilities

Customer troubleshooting and resolution

Get stuck into technical support up to L2 level, engaging directly with customers to understand what they're experiencing and guiding them confidently to a resolution.
Dig into complex technical issues, including API-related problems, using diagnostic tools and sharp instincts to find the root cause rather than just papering over the symptoms.
Build genuine trust with customers through clear communication, technical know-how, and efficient resolution, keeping our response and resolution standards front of mind on every case.
Take part in the team's on-call rota alongside colleagues across our global support locations, helping deliver the round-the-clock coverage our customers expect (locations and timings to be confirmed).

Engineering and Product collaboration

Team up with Engineering and Product to resolve client-reported bugs and broken features, arming them with the context they need to move fast.
Turn what you're hearing from customers into insight that shapes the product, helping the wider team spot patterns and recurring issues before they become bigger problems.
Keep communication sharp and real-time across internal channels, meetings, email, bug reports, and documentation, so nothing gets lost in translation on its way to a fix.

Process and documentation

Help build and refine support processes and customer-facing materials, including FAQs and troubleshooting guides, bringing ideas for how the wider function can work better as you spot the gaps.

Technical proficiency

Comfortable working within a SaaS environment, including cloud-hosted infrastructure, APIs, and the fundamentals of performance and scalability, with enough grasp of CI/CD pipelines to understand how changes make their way to production.

What we're looking for

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of experience in a dedicated technical support role with deep understanding of software and applications.
Experience working in or exposure to a SaaS environment, including cloud hosting, APIs, and an awareness of performance and scalability considerations.
Have supported maritime, shipping, commodities, logistics customers.
White glove customer service and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A learner who documents findings and is comfortable picking up new tools and systems - troubleshooting problems that do not have obvious answers.

Our Values

Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.
Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.
We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.
By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

Execute With Focus

We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.
Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.
We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.
Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

Work Together, Win Together

Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.
We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of the OS together.
Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.
By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

Arbeiten bei COSMO CONSULT ist anders.

Entdecke unser Universum und lasse Dich von der positiven Energie der COSMOnaut*innen anstecken.

Gestalte die Zukunft von und mit Menschen und wachse mit uns gemeinsam.

Erlebe echte Wertschätzung in einem sicheren Umfeld voll Leidenschaft und Innovation - ganz unabhängig davon, wann und von wo aus Du arbeiten möchtest.

Werde Teil des Teams und gehöre zu einem der weltweit führenden Microsoft-Partnern für Unternehmenstransformation und Digitalisierung.

Lebe Deinen Job anders
- bewirb Dich bei uns als

Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform)

Das macht Dich anders.

Wir sind auf einer Wellenlänge, wenn Du:

smarte Entscheidungen triffst. Du musst nicht immer die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen, aber immer mit bestem Gewissen gegenüber unseren Kunden, Kolleg*innen und COSMO entscheiden.
den Menschen bei all Deinen Überlegungen in den Mittelpunkt stellst. Du achtest auf die Bedürfnisse aller Menschen und agierst mit Empathie und Mitgefühl.
Verantwortung übernimmst. Du bist achtsam gegenüber Dir und Deinen Mitmenschen. Auf Dich kann man sich auch über Deinen Aufgabenbereich hinaus verlassen.
uns dabei unterstützt, großartige Teams zu bilden. Alle für Dich und Du für alle - gemeinsam stärker sein. Du machst den Unterschied in Deinem Team.
immer Dein Bestes gibst. Du musst nicht der oder die Beste sein, aber aus tiefstem Respekt gegenüber Dir und Deinem Umfeld immer das Bestmögliche geben.
den Mut hast zu wachsen. Du denkst nicht in Herausforderungen, sondern in Möglichkeiten. Du liebst es, Dich weiter zu entwickeln, suchst nach neuen Ideen und bringst diese aktiv ein.
Dinge mit Leidenschaft tust. Du weißt, was Dich antreibt und begeistert, lebst Deine Leidenschaft, inspirierst dadurch Dein Umfeld, hast mehr Spaß an Deiner Arbeit und bist erfolgreicher.

Deine Persönlichkeit und Motivation ist das, was Dich ausmacht.

Daher nehmen wir uns die Zeit und schauen alle Bewerbungen individuell durch.

Dein Alltag - nur ohne Alltag

Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform.
Dabei begleitest Du Projekte von der ersten Analyse über das Lösungsdesign bis zur Umsetzung und Einführung. Du verstehst die fachlichen Anforderungen unserer Kunden, übersetzt sie in tragfähige Lösungen und behältst dabei immer die End-to-End-Prozesse im Blick.

Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung übernimmst Du dabei unterschiedliche Aufgaben:

Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale.
Du führst Workshops mit Fachbereichen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten durch.
Du entwickelst strukturierte Lösungskonzepte und stimmst diese mit unseren Kunden ab.
Du setzt Lösungen selbst um oder koordinierst die Umsetzung im Team.
Du verantwortest Arbeitspakete und stellst Qualität, Standards und eine gute Dokumentation sicher.
Du bewertest Integrationen und Abhängigkeiten zu angrenzenden Systemen.
Du führst Schulungen durch und begleitest die Einführung, damit Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag nachhaltig genutzt werden.
Dabei arbeitest Du nicht nur innerhalb eines einzelnen Systems: Du denkst Prozesse, Daten und Anwendungen ganzheitlich und entwickelst Lösungen, die fachlich sinnvoll, technisch umsetzbar und langfristig skalierbar sind.

Hier bringst du Dich ein:

Du denkst Lösungen konsequent aus Nutzersicht und strukturierst sie in klare, skalierbare Use Cases.
Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungen innerhalb der Microsoft-Plattform und verbindest fachliche und technische Perspektiven.
Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und internen Teams zusammen und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zielführend zusammen.
Du entwickelst Dein Know-how kontinuierlich weiter, bleibst technologisch am Puls der Zeit und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv.
Du bringst neue Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen und gestaltest Veränderungen aktiv mit.

Dein Umfeld: Teams, Tools, Zusammenarbeit

Team & Setup

Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams mit Consultants, Entwickler*innen, Architekt*innen und weiteren Microsoft-Spezialist*innen.
Direkter Austausch mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung von Lösungen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten kombiniert mit engem Teamzusammenhalt, Wissensaustausch und fachlicher Zusammenarbeit.

Tools & Arbeitsweise

Arbeiten im Microsoft-Ökosystem rund um Dynamics 365 CRM (Sales, Customer Service und/oder Field Service), die Power Platform mit Power Apps, Power Automate und Dataverse sowie angrenzende Microsoft- und Azure-Lösungen.
Bewertung und Einsatz neuer Technologien, insbesondere zur Automatisierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie zur Nutzung von KI-Potenzialen.
Strukturierte und priorisierte Arbeitsweise, auch in parallelen Projekten und dynamischen Kundenumgebungen.
Kombination aus eigenständiger Umsetzung, fachlicher Beratung und gezielter Steuerung im Projektteam.

Deine Lernkurve bei COSMO CONSULT

Woche 1–4

Du lernst unsere Projektmethoden, Kundenstrukturen und Lösungsansätze kennen.
Du bringst Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen aktiv in laufende Kundenprojekte ein und

übernimmst frühzeitig Verantwortung für erste Themen und Arbeitspakete.

Du verstehst, wie wir Anforderungen in konkrete Lösungen übersetzen und welchen Beitrag diese zum Geschäftserfolg unserer Kunden leisten.

Nach 3 Monaten

Du verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete und setzt diese strukturiert und lösungsorientiert um.
Du arbeitest sicher mit Kunden und Projektteams zusammen und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsdesigns und Projektentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst Lösungen weiter und passt Dich flexibel an neue Anforderungen und Technologien an.

Nach 6 Monaten

Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst bestehende Lösungsansätze innerhalb von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform weiter und berücksichtigst dabei fachliche, technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.
Du bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung von Lösungen, Methoden und Prozessen ein und unterstützt den Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams.

Das bringst Du mit:

Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Umsetzung von Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
Praxiserfahrung mit der Microsoft Power Platform, insbesondere Power Apps, Power Automate und/oder Dataverse
Kenntnisse in mindestens einem relevanten Dynamics-365-Modul, zum Beispiel Sales, Customer Service oder Field Service
Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse, Systemgrenzen, Integrationen und End-to-End-Zusammenhänge
Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen zu analysieren und in klare, umsetzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen
Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Workshops und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Projektteams
Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für fachliche Lösungen und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung zu übernehmen
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Aus gesetzlichen Gründen weisen wir darauf hin, dass das kollektivvertragliche, monatliche Mindestgehalt für diese Position € 3.954,- brutto (Vollzeit) beträgt. Unsere tatsächlichen Gehaltspakete orientieren sich an aktuellen Marktgehältern und berücksichtigen selbstverständlich Deine Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Du entscheidest wann und wo, damit es für Dich, Dein Team und Deinen Arbeitstag am besten passt.
Auf Deiner Reise bist Du nicht allein. Durch unser Level Up Programm gestalten wir Deine berufliche Zukunft gemeinsam.
Wir fragen nicht ob, sondern wie. Unsere Innovation Challenge und die Trainings in unserem COSMO College sind nur einige Beispiele dafür.
Es ist uns wichtig, dass es Dir gut geht. Das bringen wir durch verschiedene Wege und Benefits zum Ausdruck.
Wir kümmern uns um Mensch und Umwelt. Mit #thepowerofpeople schaffen wir einen sicheren Raum für eine positive, nachhaltige und internationale Zusammenarbeit.

Du möchtest Teil des Teams werden?

Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinen aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen und Deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum direkt online.

First Line Software works with some of the world's top businesses and organizations in industries like healthcare, data engineering, warehouse automation, retail digitalization, mobile app development, and e-commerce. Our projects are as varied as our people, and our people are as talented as they come. We prefer working as a transparent and supportive team, who shares our knowledge as well as our success.

Let's see what we can create together!
The project and your role

Our client is rebuilding its guest-facing digital estate on a modern microservices architecture moving away from a fragmented collection of out-of-the-box portals toward a purpose-built digital platform that delivers personalised, seamless guest experiences across discovery, booking, pre-stay, and in-stay touchpoints. As a Digital Product Engineer, you'll build the digital products guests and staff use every day, working on a React/Next.js front-end and a back-end of independently deployable .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core microservices hosted on AWS.
Build and maintain guest-facing features in React and Next.js — search, the booking funnel, conversion optimisation, and promotional campaign delivery, in partnership with commercial and marketing teams
Deliver logged-in guest journeys on the guest portal, including pre-stay upsell, activity booking, and in-stay engagement
Contribute to loyalty platform features — enrolment flows, member personalisation, and loyalty mechanics
Design and build .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core microservices — REST APIs, domain logic, and integrations with core booking, CMS, and contact-center systems
Deploy and operate microservices on AWS using Lambda and ECS/Fargate, choosing the right hosting model per service
Implement event-driven communication between services using AWS SQS, SNS, and EventBridge
Design RESTful APIs to agreed standards, including OpenAPI specifications, versioning, and documentation
Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and ship through CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
Participate in code reviews with nearshore engineering partners and take ownership of your services in production, including incident response

Your skills

2+ years of software engineering experience spanning front-end and back-end development
Hands-on, production experience with React and Next.js — App Router, server components, SSR/SSG
Hands-on, production experience with .NET (Core/.NET 5+) and C#; .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core strongly preferred
TypeScript across the stack
Demonstrable experience building and deploying microservices on AWS (Lambda and/or ECS/Fargate)
Experience with RESTful API design in a microservices architecture
Experience working in agile sprint teams, ideally alongside nearshore or offshore engineering partners
Consumer-facing product experience — eCommerce, hospitality, travel, or retail preferred
English language proficiency for technical documentation and team communication

Nice to have:

Experience integrating LLMs or conversational AI (OpenAI API or equivalent)
WhatsApp Business API or Amazon Connect experience
Familiarity with hospitality CRS/PMS systems

What we can offer

Our modern stack projects are the right mix of exciting and challenging
Gain access to our diverse range of training programs, courses, and certifications
Choose your work style — this role is hybrid, with 3 days a week in the office
Enhance your language skills with our corporate English classes
Work from anywhere and explore the world with our Workation program

Technical Support Engineer - Hybrid, Spain

Technical Support Engineer

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

About The Job

The SAS Technical Support Solutions Division is looking for a Technical Support Engineer to provide technical support for customers using our SAS Real-Time Fraud Solutions. Our team provides advanced technical support for mission critical fraud platforms used by global financial institutions, ensuring high availability, performance, and effective fraud detection capabilities.

In this role, you will join a highly collaborative global team working at the intersection of systems engineering, customer success, and SAS technology. You will have the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies, solve challenging technical problems, and develop expertise across both traditional SAS 9.4 architectures and modern SAS Viya environments.

You will work closely with customers and colleagues across Technical Support, R&D, Product Management, and Professional Services to turn complex system-level issues into clear, actionable solutions and help customers get the most from their SAS environments.

As a Technical Support Engineer, You Will

Provide technical support for customers who are using or troubleshooting enterprise-class SAS software applications and/or solutions, including cloud-based environments, within strict response SLAs that may include critical incident response and escalation.
Analyze, reproduce, diagnose, and document technical problems involving transaction processing and decisioning flows, alert generation and case management, and rule execution and decisioning.
Proactively communicate carefully and effectively with customers and experts across SAS during the problem resolution process. Accurately document and specify information in the case management system during the entire support case life cycle.
Collaborate with global Technical Support colleagues, Research and Development, Product Management, Customer Success and other internal divisions to resolve customer concerns, improve product quality, identify product improvements, and support high-quality customer outcomes.
Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.
Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative field or industry domain.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in software development, software testing, an applicable business domain, software consulting, or supporting enterprise software applications.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and microservices-based applications.
Experience with Java and JVM-based applications, including debugging Java stack traces.
Working knowledge of UNIX operating system, TCP/IP networking, and database systems including Oracle, DB2, Redis, and PostgreSQL.
Previous technical support experience supporting enterprise software applications, with the ability to manage multiple customer issues and priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills

Technical Knowledge & Skills: Demonstrates strong knowledge of web technologies, operating systems, authentication, security, and performance troubleshooting.

Continuous Learning: Actively identifying new areas for learning; regularly creating and taking advantage of learning opportunities; using newly gained knowledge and skill on the job and learning through their application.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to people with different technical backgrounds.

Health Insurance
Life and Disability Insurance
Pension Plan
SAS supports your well-being with programs that reduce stress and distractions to help you stay healthy and productive.

jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:

AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission

To drive the technical execution of both high-impact feature development and the deep-dive modernization of our legacy .NET ecosystem. You will be a specialist who finds satisfaction in solving complex puzzles, utilizing AI-assisted tools to accelerate the modernization of our core systems.

Role Focus

This role focuses on high-complexity coding, deep reverse engineering, and AI-augmented productivity. You will work in the trenches of the legacy codebase, extracting logic and implementing modern, testable solutions using the latest AI-powered development environments.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Feature & Refactoring: Design and implement sophisticated new functionalities within the existing .NET ecosystem, ensuring seamless integration with legacy components.
Deep Reverse Engineering: Analyze and deconstruct complex, undocumented, or "spaghetti" legacy code to understand underlying business rules and technical flows.
AI-Augmented Coding: Proactively utilize AI coding assistants and advanced environments (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or VS Code extensions) to accelerate code comprehension, documentation, and refactoring.
Robust Testing & Stability: Write high-quality unit and integration tests to "wrap" legacy modules, providing a safety net for all refactoring efforts.
Technical Troubleshooting: Act as a high-level escalation point for complex bugs and performance bottlenecks within the legacy environment.
Internal Tooling: Utilize Microsoft PowerApps to build rapid, lightweight administrative or maintenance utilities to support the development and operations lifecycle.

Qualifications

Experience: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in the .NET/C# stack.
Legacy Navigation: Proven experience working with older .NET versions (e.g., .NET Framework) and managing the complexities of monolithic architectures.
AI Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on familiarity with AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, or local model experimentation.
Core Skills: Mastery of SOLID principles, design patterns, and advanced debugging/profiling techniques.
Testing Mindset: Strong commitment to TDD and automated testing (Unit/Integration) to protect the legacy core.

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Performance Engineering & Test Automation
jobs.description:
Kik vagyunk?

A Spice IT Zrt. 2021. végén indult azzal a céllal, hogy ügyfeleinknek innovációval,
megbízhatósággal és szakértelemmel fűszerezett tech-megoldásokat szállítsunk.
Ma már 90+ szakértőből álló csapatunk dolgozik azon, hogy minden projektünk ne csak
működjön, hanem értéket teremtsen – magas színvonalon, hatékonyan, lelkesedéssel és egy
csipet fűszerrel.
Otthon vagyunk a digitális csatornák fejlesztésében, frontend és backend rendszerek építésében, DevOps-ban, microservice-alapú és hagyományos IT-megoldásokban – és nem riadunk meg a komplex kihívásoktól sem.
Fejlesztők, tesztelők, architektek, delivery managerek és folyamat-szakértők alkotják a
csapatunkat, ahol a profi munka mellett mindig jut hely a humornak és kreativitásnak is.
Ha szereted, hogy a munkád pörög, és nem félsz új technológiákhoz nyúlni – nálunk otthon leszel.

Miről is szól ez a pozíció?

Olyan Software Engineert
keresünk, akit érdekel, mi történik a rendszer mélyén, amikor a válaszidő 200 ms-ról hirtelen 2 másodpercre nő – és nem áll meg addig, amíg meg nem találja, hogy a probléma a kódban, az adatbázisban, a hálózaton vagy az architektúrában van.
Kifejezetten olyan csapattagot keresünk, aki valódi "tech detective"
gondolkodásmóddal rendelkezik: nem elégszik meg a felszíni tünetekkel, hanem szeret leásni a kód-, adatbázis- és architektúra-szinteken, hogy feltárja a teljesítménybeli akadályok és komplex hibák valódi gyökerét (root cause analysis). Tehát: nem tesztesetek végrehajtására keresünk kollégát, hanem arra, hogy mérnöki eszközökkel segítsen gyorsabbá, stabilabbá és skálázhatóbbá tenni komplex enterprise rendszereket.

Milyen problémákon dolgozhatsz?

Miért lassul le egy API csak nagy concurrency mellett?
A JVM, az adatbázis, a hálózat vagy egy downstream service a bottleneck?
Hogyan bizonyítod méréssel, hogy egy architekturális változtatás valóban javított a teljesítményen?
Hogyan építesz performance regression tesztet a CI/CD pipeline-ba?
Hogyan reprodukálsz egy csak production-like terhelés mellett jelentkező hibát?

Miért izgalmas ez a lehetőség?

Szabadság és formálás:
Nem egy kész tesztcsomagot kell üzemeltetned - engineering szemlélettel dolgozhatsz azon, hogyan mérjük, elemezzük és javítjuk komplex banki rendszerek teljesítményét.
Valós technikai mélység:
Kód, JVM/runtime, API-k, adatbázisok, infrastruktúra, observability és architektúra – a problémák ritkán állnak meg egyetlen technológiai rétegen.
Mérhető eredmény:
Az elkészült tesztesetek száma helyett a lényeg az, hogy megtaláljuk és megszüntessük a rendszer valódi szűk keresztmetszeteit.
Engineering impact:
A megállapításaid közvetlenül hathatnak fejlesztési és architekturális döntésekre.

Mik a főbb feladatok?

Gyökérok-elemzés (Root Cause Analysis): Kód, adatbázisok, hálózat és logok elemzése a rejtett teljesítményproblémák feltárására.
Teljesítmény-optimalizálás: Bottleneckek, memóriaszivárgások és skálázhatósági kockázatok azonosítása és elemzése banki környezetben.
Kódalapú tesztautomatizálás és mérés: Automatizált terheléses és integrációs mérések építése és továbbfejlesztése.
Performance testing: Terheléses, stressz- és endurance tesztek tervezése és futtatása (pl. k6, JMeter, Gatling).
CI/CD & Shift-Left szemlélet: Automatizált és performancia tesztek beépítése a CI/CD pipeline-okba.
Architecture & Code Review: Együttműködés a fejlesztői, architekt és DevOps csapatokkal kódszintű javítások és architekturális döntések támogatásában.
Monitoring & Observability: Rendszerstatisztikák és metrikák elemzése APM és observability eszközökön keresztül (pl. Grafana, Kibana, Dynatrace).

Mik az alapvető elvárások?

Magabiztos szoftverfejlesztési alapok és gyakorlati fejlesztői tapasztalat
legalább egy modern programozási nyelven
(pl. Java, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, C# vagy Go)
"Tech detective" és kíváncsi szemléletmód:
Erős belső indíttatás és analitikus képesség a problémák gyökeréig való leásásra
Nyitottság és affinitás a szoftverminőség, a tesztautomatizálás és a teljesítmény-finomhangolás (performance tuning) iránt
Tapasztalat API-k, microservice architektúrák és adatbázisok (SQL/NoSQL) működésében és vizsgálatában
Tiszta kód elvek (Clean Code), verziókövető rendszerek (Git) és rendszerszintű technikai szemlélet ismerete.
Nyelvtudás: Minimum középfokú angol nyelvtudás
Jelenlét:
Heti 2 nap onsite jelenlét vállalása (Budapest, XIII. kerület)

Nem várjuk el, hogy minden felsorolt technológiában szakértő legyél – számunkra a fejlesztői alapok, a rendszerszintű gondolkodás és a problémamegoldó attitűd fontosabb, mint egy konkrét toolset.

Előny, ha rendelkezel

Banki vagy egyéb erősen szabályozott enterprise környezetben szerzett tapasztalattal
Ismerettel legalább egy elterjedt automatizálási vagy performancia-tesztelő keretrendszer terén (pl. k6, JMeter, Cypress, Playwright, REST Assured).
CI/CD eszközök ismeretével (GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps stb.)

Ha szívesen dolgoznál stabil, nagyvállalati környezetben, ahol a minőség és a teljesítmény

egyaránt kiemelt szerepet kap, jelentkezz vagy írj üzenetet!

Interact provides enterprise-grade intranet software that connects over three million employees to leading global names like Levi's, Domino’s, Teva Pharmaceuticals, and Technicolor.

Our team of customer-focused problem solvers are passionate about helping organizations to communicate better. We do this together by constantly working to improve every service and product we offer. With offices in Manchester, New York, Dubai, Tulsa, and Warsaw, we operate across North America, EMEA, and Australia.

Click on any of our vacancies and you’ll see one thing in common – they all begin with this message. Why? Because at Interact we treat everyone with the same respect and honesty. Whether you’re a developer fresh out of college or a seasoned salesperson, we live the motto that we uphold for our customers: our people are our most valuable assets.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer, who will be a hands-on engineer responsible for fast development of strategic functionality, AI integrations in the core product, shaping the architecture, driving engineering excellence, and delivering complex features across our platform used by millions of users globally.

A core part of the role is end-to-end execution of AI integrations into our existing ecosystem, including architecture, implementation, governance, and enablement across squads.

You will combine deep technical capability with strong leadership influence—mentoring engineers, guiding technical strategy, and personally contributing high-quality code across our stack (C#, ASP.NET, ReactJS, Node.js, SQL Server, AWS).

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy, Architecture & Hands-On Delivery

Design, build, and ship high-quality, production-grade software using C#, ASP.NET, ReactJS, Node.js, SQL Server, and AWS services.
Serve as a hands-on architect/engineer— writing foundational code, delivering end to end features, validating technical approaches through prototypes and spikes, and leading design discussions.
Maintain deep familiarity with our codebase and actively contribute to critical, high-impact features and refactoring initiatives.
Define and uphold engineering standards across squads, including SOLID, design patterns, secure coding, and observability principles.
Evaluate technical trade-offs, performance implications, and long-term maintainability to steer architectural direction.

AI Integration Ownership

Lead and implement AI-powered features across Interact’s ecosystem, to fuel value creation (eg. intelligent search, summarisation, classification, recommendation systems, generative capabilities, experience augmentation, insights generation, etc.)
Develop secure and scalable AI integration layers using modern patterns (embeddings, RAG, vector databases, prompt orchestration, evaluation frameworks).
Build and maintain AI-related services, APIs, and backend components—including telemetry, evaluation pipelines, and guardrails.
Establish best practices for responsible AI, including privacy, compliance, red-teaming, fallback logic, and model governance.
Partner with Product to prioritise AI initiatives and define measurable success metrics for user experience and business impact.
Create reusable AI components, SDKs, documentation, and guidelines for wider engineering use.

Delivery Leadership Across Squads

Lead cross-team initiatives, unblock complex technical challenges, and ensure architectural alignment across the organisation.
Work closely with Product & Delivery Managers to refine requirements, shape roadmaps, and ensure predictable delivery.
Break down complex problems and guide teams through execution—participating directly in coding when needed.

Engineering Excellence & Quality

Champion testing excellence: author and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and Playwright E2E tests.
Work closely with DevOps to optimise CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity, Octopus Deploy) and improve deployment reliability.
Conduct in-depth code reviews, provide hands-on pairing, and ensure code quality across multiple squads.
Optimise performance across APIs, databases, caching, distributed systems, and front-end rendering.

Platform Reliability, Security & Scalability

Maintain hands-on involvement in resolving complex production issues, running post-mortems, and designing long-term solutions.
Develop secure-by-default features and collaborate with Security to ensure AI and platform components meet compliance requirements.
Contribute to scalable AWS infrastructure design and cost-efficient resource usage.

Mentorship, Influence & Culture

Mentor engineers of all levels—especially Senior and Staff engineers—to elevate technical thinking and delivery quality.
Facilitate design clinics, architecture reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions, including AI education and literacy.
Contribute to hiring pipelines through technical interviews and role calibrations.

Continuous Innovation

Stay ahead of industry trends in AI, cloud, web engineering, and developer tooling.
Initiate and lead innovation spikes, proofs-of-concept, technical evaluations, and platform enhancements
Promote continuous improvement and foster a culture of curiosity and craftsmanship.

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

10+ years of professional engineering experience, including designing and delivering large-scale, distributed systems.

Real-world experience designing secure, scalable, resilient systems on AWS.

Deep knowledge of asynchronous processing, concurrency, distributed architectures, and high-volume transactional systems.
Working knowledge of Docker, containerised workloads, and cloud-native best practices.

We're looking for a mid-level Software Engineer to join our Back of House engineering team and help build, support and evolve a range of business-critical applications. Working across a range of Bravissimo applications, you'll develop APIs, backend services and event-driven solutions that support key business areas including product management, customer acquisition, ordering and fulfilment.

Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions and continuous improvement initiatives.

AWS microservice capabilities
REST APIs
Event-Driven Architecture
Grafana
GitLab
Jira

Experience with every technology isn't expected, but a willingness to learn and develop new skills is essential.

About You

You'll also:

Take pride in delivering well-thought-out solutions.
Build good working relationships across teams and contribute constructively to technical discussions.
Ask questions, challenge assumptions where appropriate, and stay curious about better ways of doing things.

Strong coding skills using TypeScript, JavaScript or a comparable modern language.
.NET development

Comfortable supporting and evolving existing business-critical applications while contributing to the development of modern cloud-native solutions.
Experience with relational databases and SQL.
Understanding of system integration patterns, APIs and event-driven architectures.

Observability, monitoring and logging platforms such as Grafana.
CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
GitLab experience.

Experience with gRPC and service-to-service integration patterns.
Exposure to financial services or another regulated environment.
Experience supporting production services, including monitoring, troubleshooting and operational resilience.

TCS is consistently voted a Top Employer in the UK and globally. Our competitive salary packages feature pension, health care, life assurance, laptop, phone, access to extensive training resources and discounts within the larger Tata network.
We offer health & wellness initiatives and sports events; we are the proud sponsor of the London Marathon.

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Location: Krakow or Warsaw

The Role:

At Logitech, we build software powering hundreds of thousands of collaboration devices deployed worldwide. Every day, our devices generate millions of telemetry events, crash reports, and quality signals that help us understand how our products perform in the field.

We are looking for a Software Quality Intelligence Engineer to join our Analytics & Quality Engineering team. This role combines hands-on software validation with analytics and investigation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the data that drives engineering decisions.

You will execute targeted test scenarios to validate that software events, logs, crash reports, and telemetry are generated correctly, verify the accuracy of analytics dashboards and quality metrics, investigate field trends and regressions, and partner with engineering teams to improve software quality through data-driven insights.

This is an opportunity to help define how software quality is measured and continuously improved across Logitech.

Design and execute manual and automated test scenarios to validate software telemetry, events, logs, crash reports, and analytics across Logitech collaboration devices.
Validate end-to-end data flow from devices through analytics pipelines to dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Analyze telemetry, system logs, and field data to identify software quality trends, regressions, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with engineering teams to investigate customer issues, perform root cause analysis, and validate software fixes.
Develop automated tools, scripts, and dashboards to monitor software quality, detect anomalies, and improve engineering visibility.
Support release readiness by providing data-driven insights into software stability, reliability, and customer impact.
Leverage AI and modern analytics techniques to accelerate data validation, quality investigations, and root cause analysis.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Experience validating software on Android or Linux-based systems.
Experience analyzing logs, telemetry, and software behavior.

CI/CD and DevOps workflows
Jira and defect management systems

Collaboration or video conferencing products

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.

Initiera och operativt ta huvudrollen i projekt inom arkitektur, plattformar, verktyg tillsammans med våra utvecklare

,

Har relevant utbildning på kandidat- eller masternivå inom IT

Har svenskt medborgarskap

Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer
for a long-term assignment involving system development and maintenance of custom-built applications and support systems within the public sector.
You will work in an environment with multiple parallel system development teams that depend on one another and iteratively deliver shared results. The custom-developed applications are built according to a target architecture and operate within an event-driven, distributed, service-oriented architecture using microservices.
The work is carried out using Agile Scrum
, and tools such as Jira
and Confluence

Assignment Description / Responsibilities

In this role, you will:
Ensure the quality of applications and systems, primarily through automated testing.
Plan and execute tests, create test cases, link test cases to requirements, report progress, and perform troubleshooting.
Conduct frontend and GUI testing.
Manage test environments and create complex test data related to release builds.
Test third-party integrations, including advanced test chains involving system components across different organizations, both internally and externally.

Drive, organize, structure, and document testing activities within the team and in coordination with other teams and stakeholders.
Lead and facilitate workshops within the testing domain.
Participate in and drive backlog refinement.
Participate in sprint planning and retrospectives while contributing to structured working methods and team progress.
Act as a support, mentor, and coach within testing, both for other testers and other system development roles.
Support the analysis and review of requirements gathering and requirement specifications.
Assume the role of Scrum Master when required.
Continuously contribute to knowledge transfer.

The consultant must:

Have worked with testing and quality assurance of custom-developed applications and systems through functional and non-functional testing, regression testing, and integration testing based on defined acceptance criteria, including traceability to requirements and changes, for at least 10 years within the last 15 years.

Have extensive knowledge and understanding of test automation, software development, JavaScript, APIs, and similar technologies, and have acted as a requirements owner/specifier for automated test development, such as regression testing.
Have worked with creating test cases and preparing and using complex test data, including SQL and databases, for at least 10 years within the last 15 years.

Have used Jira for test case management and agile workflows within and between teams, with strong expertise in the tool.
Have worked in the requested role within assignments involving multiple interdependent development teams delivering shared outcomes for at least 5 years within the last 8 years.
Have used Confluence for documentation and possess strong expertise in the tool.
Be fluent in spoken and written Swedish.

, Bruno

.

.

As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

We are looking for a Senior Engineer Remote Connectivity and IoT

You work closely with backend developers and a Product Owner focused on remote connectivity. You’ll act as a technical expert in the team, supporting both roadmap discussions and day-to-day technical decisions.

Design and improve secure and reliable connectivity solutions for products connected to cloud platforms and remote systems.
Work with connectivity architecture, remote access, integration, performance, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Take a broad technical view of the solution landscape and help define how connectivity should be designed going forward.
Evaluate current ways of working and contribute to improved technical approaches, principles, and solution design.
Dive into technical details when needed to understand how solutions are built today and how they can be strengthened over time.
Support the manager and product owner with technical direction, architecture input, and solution design.
Act as a senior technical expert who helps guide decisions and supports the team in building strong, scalable solutions.

Qualifications

A degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or similar
Solid experience in IoT connectivity and remote access solutions
Strong understanding of connected product architecture
Experience designing scalable, reliable connectivity solutions
Good knowledge of networking and protocols such as MQTT, TCP/IP, VPN, cellular, and ideally 5G
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure — cloud is especially important in this role
Good understanding of cybersecurity for connected devices and systems
Experience from products that send data from the field to backend or cloud platforms
Ability to contribute to technical direction and architecture decisions
Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mindset
Ability to explain technical topics in a clear and practical way
Fluent in English both spoken and written

It’s also a plus if you have

Experience in backend development, for example Java/Spring Boot
Experience from critical infrastructure or other industries with high demands on security and uptime

We believe you have worked as a senior engineer, system architect, or product architect within IoT, connectivity, or connected products. You probably have experience from products that are already on the market and used in real environments.

You might have worked with systems in water, pump stations, drinking water, energy, healthcare, automotive, industrial equipment, or other critical infrastructure. Exact industry is less important than having experience from connected products in real-world use.

If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Leila Sayyad, Leila.sayyad@xylem.com.

We only accept applicants through Sök efter jobb .

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Senior utvikler med .NET-erfaring – data, analyse og AI

Har du solid erfaring med .NET og lyst til å jobbe tettere på data? Hos Handelshøyskolen BI får du bruke utviklerkompetansen din til å videreutvikle en skybasert analyseplattform som gir bedre innsikt og beslutningsstøtte.

BI har allerede etablert forretningskritiske digitale produkter som brukes av titusenvis hver dag. Teknologimiljøet er produktorientert og jobber tett med virksomheten. Her får du påvirke arkitektur, teknologivalg og hvordan løsningene utvikles.

Rollen
Du blir en del av BIs analyseplattform-team. Teamet arbeider med dataflyt på tvers av systemer, analyse- og rapporteringsløsninger og en plattform for innsikt, prediksjon og beslutningsstøtte. Dere utforsker også hvordan AI og maskinlæring kan brukes i praksis.

Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å forstå hele veien fra datakilde til løsningene folk faktisk bruker. Kanskje har du jobbet mye med .NET og integrasjoner, og ønsker å bruke den erfaringen i et miljø der data og analyse står sentralt. Du får ta tekniske valg, jobbe selvstendig og samarbeide tett med både teknologer og brukere.

Teknologiene omfatter blant annet Python, Scala, PySpark/Databricks, Power BI og SQL. Erfaring med .NET, særlig C# og ASP.NET Core, er verdifull. Du trenger ikke å ha jobbet med alle teknologiene fra før, men du må ha lyst til å sette deg inn i dem.

Hvem ser vi etter?
Vi tror du vil trives i rollen hvis du:
har flere års erfaring som utvikler, gjerne med .NET
er interessert i dataflyt, analyse og AI, og ønsker å utvikle deg videre på disse områdene
har erfaring med noen av teknologiene i plattformen, eller relevant erfaring som gjør at du raskt kan lære dem
forstår hvordan data hentes inn, bearbeides og gjøres nyttige for andre
liker å ta ansvar for tekniske valg og samarbeide i tverrfaglige team
har bachelor eller master i informatikk, datateknologi eller tilsvarende
behersker norsk flytende og er komfortabel med engelsk som arbeidsspråk

Erfaring med analyseplattformer, dataintegrasjon, sky eller AI-relaterte løsninger er en fordel.
Hvorfor BI?

Hos BI får du reell påvirkning på hvordan data brukes i en stor kunnskapsorganisasjon. Du blir del av et stabilt fagmiljø med rom for kunnskapsdeling og kompetanseutvikling gjennom kurs, BI-studier og sertifiseringer.

Du får også en fleksibel arbeidshverdag med syvtimersdag, fem uker ferie og fri i romjul og påske, i tillegg til konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Vil du høre mer? Send oss gjerne CV-en din, eller ta kontakt med Sindre Ræder i Cruit på 992 25 039 for en uforpliktende prat.

Vil du bygge moderne finansløsninger med C#, Azure og AI i et av Norges ledende finanskonsern?

Data og kunstig intelligens er et strategisk satsningsområde i Storebrand. Vi har ambisjon om å bli et enda mer datadrevet konsern, hvor data og teknologi brukes til å skape bedre beslutninger, smartere prosesser og gode kundeopplevelser.

Som fullstack-utvikler blir du en del av CFO IT, et fagmiljø med ansvar for utvikling av systemer og modeller innen blant annet Solvens II og IFRS 17. Teamet utvikler skreddersydde løsninger for CFO-området og samarbeider tett med både forretningsmiljøer og andre teknologiteam på tvers av konsernet.

Hos oss får du jobbe med moderne teknologi, stor faglig bredde og spennende problemstillinger i skjæringspunktet mellom finans, data og programvareutvikling. Du får muligheten til å påvirke både løsninger, arbeidsmetoder og teknologivalg i et miljø som er opptatt av kontinuerlig forbedring og læring.

Arbeidsoppgaver
Delta i hele programvareutviklingssyklusen, fra design og utvikling til drift og videreutvikling

Utvikle og vedlikeholde skreddersydde løsninger for CFO-området

Modernisere plattformer og bidra til forbedring av arbeidsprosesser og utviklingsmetodikk

Utforske og ta i bruk nye AI-verktøy og teknologier i utviklingsarbeidet

Bidra med teknisk sparring og støtte til andre utviklere

Samarbeide tett med fagområder i CFO for å utvikle løsninger som skaper verdi for brukerne

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har minst tre års erfaring med programvareutvikling og god forståelse for hele utviklingsløpet fra idé til produksjon. Du har erfaring med C#, og det er en fordel om du også har jobbet med Azure, GitHub og SQL. Interesse for moderne teknologi, skyplattformer og AI-verktøy er viktig for å lykkes i rollen. Erfaring fra finansbransjen er ikke et krav.

Personlige egenskaper

Du er nysgjerrig, løsningsorientert og opptatt av kvalitet i arbeidet ditt. Du trives med å samarbeide med andre, deler gjerne kunnskap og motiveres av å bidra til både teamets og organisasjonens utvikling. Samtidig evner du å jobbe selvstendig, ta initiativ og drive oppgaver fremover. Du liker å lære nye ting, utfordre etablerte løsninger og utforske ny teknologi.

Vår kultur

Hos oss blir du en del av et miljø med høy faglig kompetanse, stort engasjement og kort vei fra idé til handling. Du får jobbe med spennende utfordringer, moderne teknologi og kolleger som deler kunnskap og løfter hverandre.

Vi tror de beste løsningene skapes gjennom samarbeid, nysgjerrighet og vilje til å lære. Derfor får du stor variasjon i oppgaver, gode utviklingsmuligheter og muligheten til å utforske ny teknologi og AI i praksis.

Har du driv, lærelyst og interesse for teknologi, gir vi deg verktøyene og støtten du trenger for å lykkes.

Hvorfor velge Storebrand?

Hos oss får du rom til å ta plass, bli hørt og utvikle deg i et konsern med mange muligheter. Vi er stolte av kulturen vår, drivkraften vår og den felles retningen vi jobber mot: En fremtid å glede seg til.

Vi tror på verdien av ulike perspektiver og bakgrunner, og jobber aktivt for et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø. Det blir lagt merke til: I 2025 rangerte Equileap Storebrand som nummer én i Norge og blant de tre beste selskapene i verden på likestilling. I 2026 vant vi ODA Champions.

Som fremtidsoptimister tenker vi langsiktig og investerer i løsninger som styrker oss og samfunnet rundt oss. Det er én grunn til at vi er ett av to norske selskaper i Dow Jones Best-in-Class World Index.

Hos oss på Lysaker jobber du sentralt, med gode kollektivmuligheter, sykkelparkering og garderober. Du får helseforsikring, tilgang til kiropraktor og fysioterapeut på kontoret, og gode treningsmuligheter i Storebrand Arena. I tillegg tilbyr vi en meget god pensjonsordning, gunstige forsikringer og boliglån med subsidiert rente.

Søknadsfrist: 15. oktober

Kontaktperson:
Anders Bechet, Leder CFO IT
Telefon:
+47 903 66 498
E-post:
anders.bechet@storebrand.no

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Å søke jobb i Storebrand skal være enkelt. Derfor trenger du ikke å skrive et søknadsbrev. Vi ønsker kun din CV og svar på noen få spørsmål i søknadsprosessen.

Vi tror på at mangfold styrker oss, og ønsker alle kvalifiserte søkere uansett bakgrunn og erfaring velkommen. Trenger du tilpasninger i søknadsprosessen? Ikke nøl med å gi oss beskjed – slik at vi sammen kan finne en løsning som fungerer for deg.

Storebrand samarbeider med Semac for bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg som søker og innebærer at vi verifiserer CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen. I forbindelse med bakgrunnssjekk må politiattest fremlegges for stillinger som krever autorisasjon og/eller godkjenning av egnethet.

Oslo, Norway - Full-time

The Azure Integration Architect is a senior technical expert responsible for designing and governing enterprise-grade integration solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. This role defines the architectural blueprint for connecting applications, data, and services across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

Design end-to-end integration architectures using Azure Integration Services including API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure Data Factory
Define integration patterns such as event-driven, pub/sub, request-reply, choreography, and orchestration
Develop and maintain architecture reference models, solution blueprints, and technical standards
Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and recommend the right tools and platforms for each integration scenario
Ensure architectures are designed for high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery

Solution Development & Oversight

Provide architectural guidance and technical oversight to development teams throughout the delivery lifecycle
Conduct architecture and design reviews, ensuring adherence to standards and best practices
Define API design guidelines including versioning, security policies, throttling, and documentation standards
Lead proof-of-concepts (PoCs) and pilots to validate architectural decisions

Governance & Standards

Establish and maintain the integration governance framework including naming conventions, error handling strategies, logging, and monitoring standards
Define and enforce security standards including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, managed identities, and role-based access control (RBAC)
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) in integration flows
Own the integration platform roadmap and lifecycle management

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with enterprise architects, solution architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs
Present architectural proposals and trade-off analyses to senior leadership and technical review boards
Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for all Azure integration-related topics across the organization
Support pre-sales, RFPs, or vendor evaluations where integration expertise is required

Operations & Continuous Improvement

Define observability strategies including logging, tracing, alerting, and dashboarding using Azure Monitor and Application Insights
Identify performance bottlenecks and recommend optimization strategies
Stay current with Microsoft Azure roadmap and emerging integration trends, incorporating relevant innovations

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience in software or enterprise architecture with a focus on integration
Deep expertise in Azure Integration Services: Logic Apps (Standard & Consumption), Azure API Management, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, Azure Event Hubs, and Azure Data Factory
Strong knowledge of integration and messaging patterns: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, EDI, gRPC, pub/sub, event streaming
Experience with hybrid integration scenarios using On-Premises Data Gateway or Azure Arc
Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform
Solid understanding of DevSecOps practices and CI/CD pipeline design for integration workloads
Experience with identity and security frameworks: Azure Active Directory, Managed Identities, OAuth 2.0, JWT
Familiarity with microservices architecture, domain-driven design (DDD), and API-first approaches

Preferred Qualifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Microsoft Certified: Azure Integration Services (AZ-204 or relevant specialty)
Experience with complementary platforms such as MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, or Azure API Center
Knowledge of SAP, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or other enterprise application integration
Exposure to real-time streaming with Apache Kafka or Azure Event Hubs
Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or public sector

Technical Skills Summary

Category Technologies

Integration Services Logic Apps, APIM, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, ADF

Languages & Scripting C#, Python, PowerShell, JSON, XML, XSLT

DevOps & IaC Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bicep, Terraform

Category Technologies

Security Azure AD, Managed Identities, OAuth 2.0, RBAC

Monitoring Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics

Protocols REST, SOAP, gRPC, GraphQL, AMQP, MQTT

Soft Skills

Exceptional ability to communicate complex architectural concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset
Collaborative team player who can influence without direct authority
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and making sound decisions under pressure
Passion for innovation and continuous learning

new_jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (AI & Modern Web)
new_jobs.description:
Haluatko viettää työpäiväsi vaikuttavissa projekteissa yhteisössä, joka tukee ammatillista kehittymistäsi? Senior Full Stack Developerina Nitorilla ratkaiset asiakkaiden liiketoimintakriittisiä haasteita moderneilla teknologioilla - frontendistä backendiin, ja yhä enemmän tekoälypohjaisten featureiden ja agenttisten ratkaisujen parissa, jotka muuttavat asiakkaidemme tapaa toimia.

🚀 Lyhyt kuvaus työstäsi

Senior Full Stack Developerina Nitorilla tehtäväsi voivat vaihdella selainpohjaisten käyttöliittymien ohjelmoinnista integraatioihin ja taustajärjestelmäkehitykseen.

Merkittävässä roolissa on asiakkaidemme liiketoiminnallisen fokuksen sulauttaminen kirjoittamaasi koodiin. On tärkeää, että rakentamissasi ratkaisuissa yhdistyvät suorituskyky, kustannustehokkuus ja yksinkertaisen kaunis, ylläpidettävä koodi.

Työkaluina käytössäsi ovat asiakasprojektista riippuen JavaScript, Node.js, React, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, C#, pilviteknologiat (AWS, Azure tai GCP), CI/CD-työkalut ja tietokannat. Toisinaan pääset hyödyntämään myös mahdollisia funktionaalisen ohjelmoinnin taitojasi, esim. Clojuren parissa.

Moderni ohjelmistokehitys tarkoittaa rakentamista tekoälyn kanssa. Asiakasprojektimme etenevät nopeasti tähän suuntaan - LLM-pohjaisista featureista agenttisiin ratkaisuihin, jotka muuttavat tiimien toimintaa. Jos olet jo käyttänyt tekoälytyökaluja kehitystyössäsi tai rakentanut palveluita, jotka hyödyntävät kielimalleja, löydät meiltä projekteja joissa viet tätä osaamista pidemmälle. Ja jos tekoälypohjainen kehitys kiinnostaa, mutta sopivat projektit ovat toistaiseksi puuttuneet, projektimme ja yhteisömme vievät sinua eteenpäin.

Sovellamme työssämme DevOps-mallin mukaisesti testiautomaatiota, jatkuvaa toimitusta ja muita ketteriä kehitysmenetelmiä. Yksittäisen menetelmän seuraamista tärkeämpää meille on kuitenkin itsenäinen ajattelu ja pragmaattinen tapa soveltaa hyväksi havaittuja käytäntöjä.

Vielä lisää konkretiaa

Asiakasprojektimme ovat tyypillisesti haastavia ja samalla ammatillisesti palkitsevia kokonaisuuksia, jotka tarjoavat kokeneelle ohjelmistokehittäjälle mahdollisuuden sekä hyödyntää että syventää osaamistaan. Projektien kesto on usein vuodesta useampaan vuoteen riippuen omista toiveistasi. Useimmissa projekteissa toimit osana asiakkaan kehitystiimiä, jossa on mukana myös useampi muu kokenut nitorilainen. Tutustu tulevan kollegasi Marion Bhuptan tarinaan ja miten hän on kasvanut kokeneeksi full stack -asiantuntijaksi Nitorilla.

Kiinnostaako lukea lisää teknogiavalinnoistamme? Kehittäjäkyselymme 2026 paljastaa ajankohtaiset teknologiatrendit.

AI-pohjainen kehitys ei ole meillä vain slogan - 73% nitorilaisista käyttää tekoälytyökaluja päivittäin. Lue lisää AI-kyselystämme !

✅ Mitä sinä voisit tuoda mukanasi?

Tässä tehtävässä loistat, kun sinulla on syvä ymmärrys siitä, miten modernit web-sovellukset ja digitaaliset palvelut toimivat ja rakentuvat. Hallitset koko kehitysketjun frontendistä backendiin ja ymmärrät miten ne toimivat yhdessä.

Emme ole tarkkoja kokemusvuosien suhteen, mutta olemme huomanneet, että 8+ vuotta kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä erilaisten palvelujen ja tuotteiden parissa auttaa sinua toimimaan asiakasprojekteissasi lisäarvoa tuovana asiantuntijana.

Sinulla on vahva osaaminen useammasta ohjelmointikielestä ja vähintään yhdestä pilviteknologiasta (AWS, Azure tai GCP). Asiakasprojekteissamme ovat yleisesti käytössä muun muassa JavaScript, Node.js, React, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin ja .NET. Lisäksi sinulla on kokemusta CI/CD-työkaluista ja tietokannoista.

Koska full stack -kehittäjän työ on monipuolista ja vaatii yhteistyötä eri sidosryhmien kanssa, arvostamme konsultatiivista ja asiakaslähtöistä ajattelutapaa. Sinun tulee ymmärtää asiakkaan tarpeita ja osata kommunikoida teknisistä ratkaisuista. Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen osaaminen on tärkeää, sillä asiakkaita on sekä kotimaassa että kansainvälisesti.

Tekoälypuolella arvostamme kokemusta agenttisten tekoälytyökalujen, kuten Claude Coden, käytöstä osana kehitystyötä sekä käytännön kokemusta palveluiden tai featurejen rakentamisesta LLM-rajapintoja hyödyntäen. Uteliaisuus siitä, mihin tekoälykehitys menossa, on tärkeää - olipa kyse sitten agenttiframeworkeista kuten LangChainin Deep Agents tai OpenAI Agents SDK, observability-työkaluista kuten LangSmith tai tekoälyalustoista kuten Microsoft AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock tai Google Vertex AI.

Eduksi on, jos olet miettinyt, miltä CI/CD näyttää, kun järjestelmäsi on ei-deterministinen - miten esimerkiksi testaat ja evaluoit LLM-pohjaisia featureita luotettavasti.

Et kuitenkaan tarvitse kokemusta kaikesta tästä - mutta jos agenttinen, GenAI-pohjainen featurekehitys innostaa sinua, tarjoamme siihen erinomaiset mahdollisuudet.

🏆 Mitä jos valitsisitkin meidät?

Uskomme, että rekrytoinnissa ei ole kyse siitä, että yritys valitsee uuden työntekijän. Sinä lopulta teet valinnan. Ja me voimme sinua siinä auttaa.

Sinun kannattaa olla meihin yhteydessä, jos:
haluat työskennellä merkityksellisten, pitkäaikaisten asiakassuhteiden ja -projektien parissa - myös projekteissa, joissa tekoäly on todellinen osa sitä, mitä rakennat
rinnallasi työskentelevät osaavat kollegat, erinomaiset kehittymismahdollisuudet sekä optimaaliset työolosuhteet ovat sinulle tärkeitä
koet, että yhteisöllisyys ja kollegoille hyvän tahtominen ovat työelämässä merkityksellisiä arvoja
sinusta on ihan ok tehdä normityöaikaa ja huolehtia, että vapaat ja työt pysyvät balanssissa
haluat työskennellä koko kehitysketjussa fronttendistä backendiin

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
in a self-organized Scrum team, you will:

Design, implement, and maintain new features across both front-end and back-end (SOA).
Take technical ownership of feature delivery, ensuring high quality, scalability, and performance.
Drive automation-first approach: design, implement, and maintain E2E, API, Integration tests.
Perform manual exploratory testing for complex scenarios.
Define test strategies at feature/module level.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Technical Leads, and teammates during analysis, refinement, and development.
Contribute to architectural discussions and participate in technical decision-making
Mentor and support less experienced engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
Drive improvements in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and development tools.
Ensure adherence to engineering best practices (XP, TDD, clean code).
Engage in Sprint Reviews/Demos and continuous process improvements

What We Value

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
5+ years of professional experience with C# (.NET or .NET Framework) and Angular.
Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications. in.NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular.
Demonstrated expertise in automation frameworks and CI/CD
Solid understanding of manual testing techniques and QA best practices.
Comprehensive understanding of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures
Deep knowledge of CI/CD processes and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps).
Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure and building/managing pipelines
Readiness to learn APL, developing new features and debugging existing functionality, with full support from our team throughout the learning process.
Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns with experience in Domain Driven Design
Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, CI).
Experience with relational databases (SQL).
Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), written and spoken
Ability to mentor, guide, and inspire other developers.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms.
Background in FinTech or capital markets.
Knowledge and experience in the financial domain, fintech, derivatives (options, futures, swaps, etc.) is an advantage.

Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process.

To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to=back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. Here Is What Your Role Entails

As our Quality Assurance Intern, you will help establish and improve quality assurance processes, standards, and testing practices across our software solutions. You will contribute to evaluating and enhancing testing methodologies, ensuring that quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also be involved in the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated tests to improve efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.

During your internship, you will gain hands-on experience with:

Jira and Xray for requirements, issue, and test management.
C# and xUnit for automated testing.
Playwright for UI and end-to-end test automation.
API testing and validation of backend services.
Test case design and test strategy.
Exploratory, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Agile development processes and collaboration in cross-functional teams.

You will be involved in all phases of the projects, from idea to finished product, giving you valuable insight into different aspects of software development and quality assurance. You will start with simpler tasks to become familiar with the team, product, and technologies, and gradually take on more advanced responsibilities as your knowledge and confidence grow throughout the internship. By the end of the internship, you will have gained practical experience designing test cases, testing APIs and user interfaces, working with automated tests, and contributing to the quality of real-world software solutions used by customers around the world.

Meet your future team

You will join a collaborative and supportive global team of 40 dedicated colleagues. Together, we work to ensure that Kamstrup’s web applications remain robust and efficient whether that means developing new features, solving UI-related issues, or improving overall performance. We value teamwork, continuous learning, and a positive work environment. In our team, we grow by supporting one another, tackling challenges together, and celebrating each other’s successes.

Did you know? Our team ships code and memes. Our internal chat is approximately 70% software development questions, 20% deployment updates, and 10% carefully curated memes.

Less About Us, More About You

We are looking for a motivated student who is eager to apply their theoretical knowledge in a practical setting and contribute to the development of high-quality software at Kamstrup.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

Are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field, and have a strong interest in Quality Assurance
Can work independently, but also value teamwork and professional sparring with your colleagues
Are structured, take responsibility for your tasks, and are not afraid to take initiative or seek solutions
Bring a proactive mindset and a desire to learn and grow in a professional environment

In addition, it is a requirement that you are fluent in English – both spoken and written. Danish is not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

The internship is paid if your place of study allows it
Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches
Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic
An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions to the internship position, please contact Quality Assurance Manager, Nora Gomez Pascual, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

____________________

Get to know us

At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driven by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us. Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Job Description

About the Role

We are looking for a .NET Backend Developer to join our team!

We strongly believe that “Ideas power everything!”, so here you’ll find the context where all your initiatives not only will be heard, but really appreciated!

We're building a large-scale, enterprise-grade web platform on a modular microservice architecture. As a backend engineer, you'll own the full lifecycle of domain services — from data modelling and business logic through API design, messaging contracts, database migrations, and production deployment.

You'll work in a multi-vendor setup alongside DevOps, architecture, and product teams.

Responsibilities

Design, build, test, and operate microservices following a read/write service-pair pattern (read-only delivery APIs + write-capable update/ingestion services)
Implement event-driven communication between services
Own your domain end-to-end: schema design, API contracts, persistence, messaging, and production monitoring
Contribute to shared platform libraries and tooling
Document architectural decisions and service designs for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Required Technical Skills And Experience

C# / .NET 8 – Web API development, modern C# features (records, pattern matching, nullable reference types, async/await best practices)
Entity Framework Core - code-first migrations, specification pattern, repository abstraction
Microservice architecture - clear separation of concerns across layered services (controller → service → repository)
Entity Framework Core - code-first migrations, specification pattern, repository abstraction
Authentication & Authorization - JWT validation, Azure AD / Entra ID, OIDC
Third-party API integrations (DAM systems, CRM/marketing platforms, email dispatch)

Nice To Have

Event-driven messaging - publishing and consuming messages on a service bus (MassTransit, NServiceBus, or similar), contract-first design, idempotency
Azure - AKS (Kubernetes), Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Table Storage, Key Vault, Managed Identity, Azure Functions (isolated worker model), Azure AI Search
Experience with CDN cache invalidation (e.g. Akamai FastPurge API)
Redis caching strategies
Roslyn Analyzers / Code Fix Providers
PDF generation libraries

Other Requirements

Experience working in a client-facing role, interacting with both technical and non-technical stake-holders
Experience working in agile, multi-vendor environments
Must be fluent in English, written and verbal communications
